founderAuthorization.rule: Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane; implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue; never modify a pending package's branch, bundle, clone, evidence or cycle state.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Tests and non-protected documentation only; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge.

rationale: audit/KNOWN-TARGET-MACHINE-PENDING.md listed Windows process lock / kill / crash / restart / resume tests as pending; this package runs them on the target machine with real child processes for the process lock and the unattended orchestrator.
scenarios: a killed lock holder leaves a same-host dead-PID lock that is taken over; the live holder is detected first
five concurrent invocations produce exactly one winner
unreadable and foreign-host locks stay fail-closed and are not cleared

an orchestrator worker killed mid-action keeps its lease until expiry, then a new worker takes it over as stale, recovers the in-flight action and completes it without a second provider call, with a verifiable transition log
a corrupted main state file falls back to the previous copy, the log stays verifiable and the chain continues
